scope: Read-only engineering reference bound to the four input-manifest parent runs; not a current-version paired performance experiment. No model, pipeline, replay, or tests executed.
interpretation_rules: Missing fields remain null with availability=field_not_recorded; skipped/not_run stages are not converted to zero.
Propagation coverage counts are computed only because all four original propagation artifacts exist and record an executed status.
no_excess_established is unresolved evidence, not a safe or negative verdict. All reported zero reductions mean observed null reduction outputs, not proof of data minimality.
Public token totals count input+output; cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not extra tokens. Public total_usage_known does not establish provider-internal billing completeness.
Analysis elapsed, native wall span, and summed request durations measure different intervals.
Model/effort/provider are confirmed requested CLI settings; public launch receipts do not independently certify the provider model actually served.
Inherited GA4 upstream usage remains separate from new-run cost.
